scope: Thirty-three audited substitution-preposition sites: seven in 44-book and 26 in the base papers.
choice: Normalize Vmesto/vmesto, Naměsto/naměsto and spaced Na město/na město to official Vměsto/vměsto.
motivation: All 33 sites mean instead of, in place of or rather than; none denotes a physical place or the separate imaje město construction. Official type-1 vměsto bridges the attested East, West and South variants and already controls 68 source sites.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining unaccented vmesto would preserve a spelling error in the selected lemma.
Retaining compact naměsto and spaced na město would preserve branch-conditioned doublets without a semantic distinction.
A global město edit was rejected because 362 non-target place/existence-family occurrences must remain untouched.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official dictionary id 2531 gives vměsto (+2), preposition type 1, instead of / Anstatt von.
evidence.german_alignment: The German authority uses statt, statt dessen, anstelle and an Stelle von at the mapped sites.
evidence.semantic_audit: All 33 sites express substitution or replacement, including formula/symbol replacement, assumptions, constructions and anaphoric vměsto toga; physical-place cases are zero.
evidence.protected_domains: No target occurs in a comment, foreign-language/title argument, URL, proper name, label/reference or TeX control name.

validation.coverage: Exact six-form histogram totals 33 with the expected 7/0/26/0 file split.
validation.failed_dry_run: The first dry-run correctly rejected an overbroad place-family guard because it counted the nine spaced source phrases themselves; the guard was narrowed to non-target place/existence occurrences before any write.
validation.postcondition: All six source forms are zero, canonical Vměsto/vměsto totals 101, and 362 non-target place/existence-family occurrences remain invariant.
validation.structure: Line counts, braces, ordered TeX controls and math delimiters are invariant; 45-isv.tex and bib-isv.tex are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: Corrected frozen successor reproduced twice before atomic application and matched after application.
